title: Mopsa the Fairy
author: Jean Ingelow
description: "Mopsa the Fairy" by Jean Ingelow is a children's fantasy novel written in the early 20th century.
longDescription: The story follows a young boy named Jack, who embarks on a whimsical adventure after discovering a hollow tree filled with fairies.

authorInfo.bio: Jean Ingelow (1820–1897) wrote Mopsa the Fairy. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
